itens.titulo: 10-year Treasury note yield hits highest level since 2002 as traders brace for key bond sale
itens.descricao: 10-year Treasury note yield hits highest level since 2002 as traders brace for key bond sale CNBC
trechos: Treasury yields climbed Wednesday, trading back around multiyear highs, as traders braced for the sale of 10-year notes at a time when rising yields have rattled investors around the world.
The benchmark 10-year Treasury was up nearly 8 basis points at 5.35% — its highest level since 2002.
The 30-year Treasury bond rose 8.3 basis points to 5.724%, also reaching a 24-year high.
The 2-year Treasury note yield was up 2.7 basis points to 4.818%.
One basis point equals 0.01%, and yields and prices move in opposite directions.

The Treasury plans to sell $39 billion of 10-year notes in an auction on Wednesday that will test whether yields are now attractive enough to draw buyers or investors will demand an even bigger premium, amid concerns about inflation, debt levels and term risk.
The auction's results will be released at 1 p.m.
The government sold $58 billion in 3-year notes on Tuesday and is scheduled to sell $22 billion 30-year bonds on Thursday.

itens.titulo: Ibovespa opera no zero a zero após rali eleitoral; dólar sobe e toca os R$ 5
itens.descricao: Ibovespa opera no zero a zero após rali eleitoral; dólar sobe e toca os R$ 5 Exame
trechos: O Ibovespa iniciou a operação em queda nesta quarta-feira, 7 de outubro, rondando a estabilidade, e devolvendo os ganhos da abertura em meio à pressão de Vale e de parte do setor financeiro.
Por volta das 10h43, o principal índice da B3 recuava 0,15%, aos 205.524 pontos.
O dólar comercial sobe 0,32%, cotado a R$ 4,9915, depois da forte queda observada no primeiro pregão após as eleições.
Segundo o Itaú BBA, o Ibovespa acumula alta de 11% em outubro e já passou a refletir um cenário de ajuste fiscal gradual.
Entre os papéis de maior peso, Petrobras sobe 0,47% (PETR3) e 0,58% (PETR4), acompanhando a alta do petróleo no exterior.
Vale (VALE3), por outro lado, recua 1,48% e exerce pressão sobre o índice.
Magazine Luiza (MGLU3) avança 4,11%, Vamos (VAMO3) sobe 3,66% e MRV (MRVE3) ganha 2,81%.
Na outra ponta, Santander Brasil (SANB11) cai 1,75%, Metalúrgica Gerdau (GOAU4) perde 1,63% e CSN (CSNA3) recua 1,43%.

itens.titulo: UBS Flags a Bullish Setup in Tesla Stock and Lifts Its Price Target
itens.descricao: UBS Flags a Bullish Setup in Tesla Stock and Lifts Its Price Target Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - UBS analyst Joseph Spak raised Tesla's price target to $391 and kept his Buy rating, calling TSLA's risk/reward tactically favorable after shares dropped 17% over the past year.

- Tesla trades at 396x earnings because investors price in robotaxi ambitions and AI rather than quarterly profits, and that dynamic was on full display when Q2 EPS missed by 38% yet shares still gained 9% in the 30 days after.
- Weak fundamentals lurk beneath the bullish setup: operating margin sits at 1%, free cash flow hit -$1.09B, and automotive margins slipped from 19% to 16%.
(Sponsor) UBS analyst Joseph Spak raised his price target on Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) to $391, according to UBS from $385, according to UBS and kept his Buy rating.
Tesla shares trade at $378.02, down 16.6% over the past year and 15.94% year to date.
They are also up 7.14% over the past week and 6.76% over the past month.
In Q2 2026, Tesla earned $0.33 per share, missing the $0.5367 estimate.
The stock fell 14.52% on the day of the report, then gained 9.15% over the next 30 days.

itens.titulo: BitMine Is About to Stop Buying Ethereum: What Happens to ETH Price Then?
itens.descricao: BitMine Is About to Stop Buying Ethereum: What Happens to ETH Price Then? Yahoo Finance
trechos: BitMine Immersion Technologies, the largest company holder of Ethereum (ETH), will stop buying once it owns 5% of all ETH.
Chairman Tom Lee told the Token2049 conference in Singapore on Wednesday the firm is about 100,000 ETH away.
BitMine began buying on June 30, 2025, with ETH near $2,500.
After 15 months and 6 million tokens, ETH trades at $2,581.
How Close Is BitMine to the 5% Mark?
BitMine reported 6,016,414 ETH as of October 4, about 4.9% of supply.
The remaining 89,000 ETH would cost about $230 million at the current ETH price.
"We only need to get another 100,000 ETH to get to 5%," Lee stated at the Token2049 in Singapore.

itens.titulo: Broadcom's AI Revenue Is Growing at 221%. Here's Why Custom Chips Could Be a Bigger Business Than GPUs.
itens.descricao: Broadcom's AI Revenue Is Growing at 221%. Here's Why Custom Chips Could Be a Bigger Business Than GPUs. Yahoo Finance
trechos: Broadcom's AI Revenue Is Growing at 221%.
Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) grew its artificial intelligence semiconductor revenue by 221% year over year in the third quarter, and that growth could accelerate in the fourth quarter.
Management's outlook calls for $21.7 billion worth of AI-related revenue, up 236% from a year ago.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
If the useful life of an AI server is six years, that increases the return on investment from about 200% to about 500%.
